description.value: Ba Le Deli & Bakery is a family-owned Vietnamese delicatessen that has been baking its own baguettes and crafting bánh mì sandwiches in Vancouver since 1987. The Rupert Street shop is one of several Lower Mainland locations, offering a menu that spans classic Vietnamese cold cut subs, vegan and vegetarian options, vermicelli bowls, and desserts. For cyclists moving through East Vancouver, it is a quick, affordable stop for a filling handmade sandwich.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 10m; stands (2 spaces) at 14m; rack (7 spaces) at 16m; stands (2 spaces) at 20m; rack (3 spaces) at 49m; stands (15 spaces, covered) at 77m. Total: 31 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (balebanhmi.com) confirms the Rupert St location at 3779 Rupert St, Vancouver, BC V5M 3W2 with phone (604) 336-7747, both matching OSM tags. The menu page explicitly lists multiple vegan and vegetarian bánh mì items, and the contact/order pages confirm delivery and pickup availability at this branch. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Ba Le Deli & Banh Mi' but the website consistently uses 'Ba Le Deli & Bakery' as the trading name. The website name appears to be the current correct name.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating Vietnamese deli with the Rupert St location confirmed on its own website; a practical food stop for touring cyclists in East Vancouver.
